title: A Undertow for the Wardrobe
author: Mara Dravenmoor
blurb: Marguerite Eastwick, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
